note: clean = first reply parsed; repaired = one corrective retry parsed; fell-through = both replies malformed (the stated fallback fires); unmeasured = the host or transport failed, which is not evidence about the model. Dated and per-model: free-tier catalogs churn, so this result must not be generalized to a tier or a family.
retry: This is the retry of a prior unmeasured result (host previously exceeded the adapter's 600000ms invocation timeout). Before retrying, a direct reachability check (curl, 10s bound) against the corsair endpoint returned no response at all (exit 28, connection timed out, no TCP handshake completed). The retry was attempted anyway through the real instrument: `node scripts/probe-model-contract.mjs --model corsair/glm-4.7-flash --binary /opt/homebrew/bin/opencode --trials 1`. The namer invocation was still unanswered after more than 20 minutes wall-clock (twice the adapter's own per-invocation timeout) when the surrounding node process exited without completing its own timeout handling, orphaning the spawned `opencode run` child, which was still blocked waiting on the corsair host and was terminated manually. A second reachability check immediately after showed the same zero-response timeout. Recorded unmeasured per this exercise's own rule: a host that will not answer is not evidence about the model.

runs.reason: corsair host unreachable: direct reachability check timed out with no response (10s bound), and the live invocation through the pinned host adapter was still pending after more than 20 minutes with no reply before requiring manual termination
not attempted: the namer invocation never returned, so the script did not reach the densifier seam
